question:
Select the correct mirror image of the given figure when the mirror is placed at MN as shown below.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f9ada5573cd1f2e0836ee039c1baa989492789cb3c868b62eda0d3ce768fbe5b.png]
solution:
The correct mirror image of the given combination when the mirror is placed at MN is as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c27fde5efbbad3bb0287553fef7f6c3fd1b6cfdb255313c244b0e0e91cc8acca.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option (1)".**

__**Detailed Explanation:**__

__**​​​**__The line MN is the mirror.

__
 
• The word ends in 'g', thus the mirror image should start with a mirror image of 'g'.
 
• Which is correctly depicted in option 1 only. → Option 2, Option 3 and Option 4 are eliminated.
 
• in option 2, the mirror images of g, t, r, e and P are wrong → Eliminated.
 
• Further in options 3 and 4, the mirror images of various characters are wrong, thus these options is also eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The mirror always forms the laterally inverted images, i.e. left changes to right and vice versa.
 
• The reflection of an object in the water is called its water image.
 
• The water image of an object in the water is always vertically inverted, i.e. Upside changes to down and vice versa.
 
• The water image is the mirror image in case if the mirror is placed horizontally below the object.

82:T
